test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six people are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Q is to the immediate left of S and third to the right of T while K is third to the left of O. K is to the immediate right of S and second to the left of M. Who is the immediate left of M?
solution:
According to the given information:

Q is to the immediate left of S and third to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4f879a2cc867cdc611fa8731cd97e84820100021e7f4f843a95828a4c4243bb.png] 

K is to the immediate right of S and second to the left of M.
